source: Reviews and photos from people who bought this lamp from the same seller we order from.

reviews.name: Mimi
reviews.text: It's really pretty however you've gotta put a lot of effort into building it as it's very fragile and difficult to build 🙌

reviews.name: A buyer
reviews.text: It is very good product everything was there in the kit very good

reviews.name: Sephali
reviews.text: Very nice my daughter and I love it

reviews.name: Sathi
reviews.text: You will not get this as a lamp (as shown in the photo)... the order will give you all the essential materials to set up the lamp + you have to have your own glue gun... product is nice but go for it only if you can set up all those things all together

reviews.name: Anoop
reviews.text: Product bahut hi achcha aaya hai, jodne mein bahut time lagega

reviews.name: A buyer
reviews.text: All good but light is very bad quality, used my own light for this
